title: A Finger's Width Short

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A finger that goes to the shelf and toward the ear is still a finger short of the gap; the gap keeps its own name.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln basket-women at the loaf shelf

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and twenty-six to four hundred and twenty-eight days, six months and two hundred and forty-six to two hundred and forty-eight days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 426 exact at the opening on answer 426, closing at 428 exact on answer 432. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 2, 3 and 4 are three ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words; there is no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner on any of them, and nothing from Ilmen 30's third reading or its two sightings crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. The month goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned; six honest answers 427 through 432 stand on the sixth place, two to each day, and not one is a doctrine. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings stand with no tenth; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule; three readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, three being three and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid; the two sightings stay on separate trays with no eighth of either. Silt 10 (Day 434), the month's first reading and the year's fourth, waits six mornings beyond the close as a date and is not brought.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Second Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{426}{Silt 2, Y.H. 814, Secondday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 426 and the count exact at 425, six months and two hundred and forty-five days told by nobody, with no next hand in the room; then first light, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Secondday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only. Ilva offstage with her count still in wood, Hessa's slate unread up the road and Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket; no market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eleventh arithmetic or eighth opening, and no slate opened within reach of the basket. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). A detail of the horn-hard crust and the cold joint brings one untagged past-tense fragment of the surgeon's register, no present-tense break, no \memory{} tag, the old life riding the register alone (T004). Sella's whole hearth grammar holds at the morning: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, small intake/hold/letting-go with neither gap figured, finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally underneath stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, widow's mark untouched because a Secondday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the tighter wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100). Answer 427 comes out and is filed on the sixth place; the count reaches 426 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-six days, told by nobody, and he does not stand the number up as a threshold or lay the twelve old arithmetics and the three readings gone up the road across one another, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Second Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 2 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 428 filed and the count at 426 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-six days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the ordinary yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine, Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr gone up the clay road with the third subtraction locked inside, the soft-cuffed clerk still reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting, a witness or a tenth hand. The offered figure, the asking answered with the weather, the second man's turned slate and direction, the clerk's entered figure and the fifth shaping stay found where put and are not repeated on a day that earned only its second; no collector comes up or down the clay road and Silt 10 waits six mornings off as a date. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather — pail down on the flat stone, rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure — and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands. He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back (T098, T009/T013/T092). The trough keeps the gone pan's shallow round print on a place of its own, not laid across the loaf's stopping or the ridge; at the Vail corner the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw beside the called-gone grey of the ridge with a finger between, a thing left in place not a thing forgiven, and the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note runs nearer under the winter skin — found where put, called weather, not looked twice, not a sign, a fourth covering or a payment (T083/T085/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather: a fist opens toward the well, looks at the light and returns into a sleeve and arrives nowhere; a woman sent for a pot's cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the arithmetic read over the covered grain does not know what it cost and the ink-neat space between figure and price has no signature (T077). At the going of the light Sella's whole grammar returns; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, the keeping at the fold is found where put with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, and under the boards the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for four hundred and twenty-six days (T088). The small hours bring the towel out as instruments come out when a case is done; the surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side and neither buys the other, and answer 428 is filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082, T071/T072).

scenes.title: The Third Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{427}{Silt 3, Y.H. 814, Thirdday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 428 and the count exact at 426, six months and two hundred and forty-six days told by nobody; then first light, the carrying-down and the morning of an ordinary Thirdday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge before the carrying-down; Garl Vail in objects. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner; the third reading, the two market sightings and the turning of the month stay behind and do not come under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; nothing from Silt 2 crosses into Silt 3 as a lesson or a custom. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict (T060/T086/T097). The morning's honest work is given its exact texture — tallow and woodsmoke, wet wool, the pot board, the half-beat at the setting, the dressed grain turned and covered, a fist of barley judged by the hand that carries it — and the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive. Tarn keeps six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl Vail's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* once in the tone of a man stating the weather, found where put and not made a habit, not a tenth stopping, payment, hearing or rule, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled in a term already ended and his valuable ear exposure rather than safety (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past his bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise to the men who burn slates stays neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Answer 429 is filed; the count reaches 427 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-seven days, told by nobody, and the fire's fifth is unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T071/T072, T088).

scenes.title: What the Third Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 3 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 430 filed and the count at 427 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-seven days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage, Hessa's slate unread, Berr's box locked up the road, the clerk's entered figure a report and not a sighting; day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's one meaningful change (advanced and NOT paid; T097 with T060/T086, and brushing T100 and T015/T041/T047).** In the afternoon, at the Vail loaf shelf, a neighbour with a pot reaches past the bare board before her eyes find the basket, the way neighbours have reached before; her finger goes along the top of the shelf where the charcoal tally lies beneath and then, without her seeing it, in the direction of the empty place at the boy's ear. She stops a finger's width short of the fold, calls the row's old gap a thing the turning of the month brought in and the empty place a child's appetite in one breath without seeing she has made two rooms one absence, and goes off with her pot. The boy takes the reaching apart by the order of its parts — hand to the board before eye to the basket, mouth after both, the half-beat in the gap where a joining would have stood — and files it on a place of its own beside the earlier shapings and the far-off finger: a further shaping, advanced and NOT paid, no joining, no name, no figure, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no finger of his laid across the space, no reading or copying of the charcoal, no account and no payer standing. He does not make the neighbour's near-joining his own and does not lay it across the twelve arithmetics, the three readings gone up the road, the printed figure, the fifth shaping, the offered figure or the clerk's entered figure (T080/T090/T102 held, T100 held). The rest of the afternoon keeps its grammar: the seven walked-around places once and not twice, the trough's round print on its own place, the two unswept lines at the Vail corner with a finger between, the softening at the river's skin called weather and not made a sign, a fist arriving nowhere, a woman sent to a pot getting a note and not a price (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092, T077). At the going of the light Sella's grammar closes the day, the widow's mark untouched, the keeping at the fold found where put and not made again, four low pulls under the floor and the fifth not supplied (T058/T079, T088, T097). The small hours file answer 430 on the sixth place — exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, laid across neither the neighbour's near-joining nor any other kept thing — and the surgeon's register and the infant's want stand side by side, the second louder, neither winning (T061/T082, T071/T072).

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{428}{Silt 4, Y.H. 814, Fourthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 430 and the count exact at 427, six months and two hundred and forty-seven days told by nobody; then first light and the morning of an ordinary Fourthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 3 — not the neighbour's near-joining at the shelf, not any yard saying — crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). Sella's whole hearth grammar holds at the morning, ahead of the basket in every order: the coals told it was the thaw, turned with a broken pot's back, the intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread after yesterday's near-reaching, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, repair held apart from restoration, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100). The widow's mark hangs where it hangs; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and no eighth comes due on a Fourthday that has earned only its fourth. Tarn's sentence is found where put and not made a habit, Jorra's finger takes the cold out of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and comes out without the extra holding of Ash 26, and the two quiet men under one roof stay unjoined (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062). Answer 431 is filed on the sixth place; the count reaches 428 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-eight days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, and he stands no number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure, for a number counted is a number with air around it and air buys no warmth (T071/T072, T088).

scenes.title: What the Fourth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Silt 4 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 432 filed and the count at 428 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-eight days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put and not spent: Tarn at kindling and flagstones with the sentence held and the loan uncalled; Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper with the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine, the offered figure and its return on their own place beside the fifth shaping; Hessa's slate unread up the road with her eighth hand eighth; Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and entered figure reported at the out-of-line landing; the three likenesses of Slate Row, the second man's direction and turned slate, the first man's face and the well-asking answered with the weather on their own trays with a finger between every pair; the neighbour's near-joining of shelf and fold from Silt 3 on its own place, not repeated on an unearned day and not made a custom; the two market sightings of Ilmen 30 on separate trays with no eighth of either; the softening at the river's skin kept as weather; the green at the pot board and the shape at the market's edge as sightings with no eighth. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second well-telling, no repetition of the offered figure, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: afternoon small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; the seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place; the trough bare and dark with the gone pan's round print on a place of its own; costs arriving as directions and going away as weather and leaving no entry; the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw kept beside the called-gone grey with a finger between, the softenings found where put, called weather and not looked twice (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092, T077). At the going of the light Sella's whole grammar returns and closes the day, her hands never still when they have nothing to do, counting spoons and nails and the breaths of a child nobody numbers and coming back to the hairline at the wire; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain is turned under wool and covered and unfigured, the pot rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the keeping at the fold is found where put and stays a finding with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T058/T079, T060/T086/T097). The towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done; the file turns out exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the heard bell keeps beside the told bell with both gaps in their own squares, three counts in three places staying three, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, seven openings in seven months and not a rule, and three readings behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine out of three, the twelve not laid across the three and Silt 10 waiting six mornings off as a date and not brought (T061/T082, T015/T041/T047, T078, T071/T072). The surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work; the unsent call to Nina is not paid again (T020 held). Answer 432 is filed on the sixth place, six honest answers 427 through 432 standing there, two to each of the three days and not one a doctrine. The note under the winter skin ends on its own finishing; the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it, the inch not a reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ends, and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — and there is no next hand in the room. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. Four low pulls breathe under the floor and the fifth is not supplied.
